title: Rumi on the Heart: Courage and the Fire Within
subtitle: Eight Persian Sufi poems with English translation
yt_title: Rumi on the Heart | 8 Persian Sufi Poems with English Translation
intro: In Rumi's language, the heart is not just a feeling. It is the place where we meet what is real.
It can be hard as stone, and still hold a fire.
Here are eight passages about the heart and the courage it asks of us.

poems.name: Listen to the Heart

lines.en: Listen to the heart's subtle points that have no words,

lines.fa: و آنچ اندر فهم ناید فهم کن
lines.en: and understand what does not fit into understanding.

lines.fa: در دل چون سنگ مردم آتشی است
lines.en: In people's hearts, though they are like stone, there is a fire

lines.fa: کو بسوزد پرده را از بیخ و بن
lines.en: that burns the veil from root to branch.

tafsir: Rumi asks for a kind of listening beyond words.
Even hearts that seem like stone have a fire hidden in them.
Think of flint: strike it, and a spark appears.
No heart is truly dead. The fire is waiting.

poems.name: The New Form

lines.fa: در میان جان و دل پیدا شود
lines.en: Between soul and heart there appears

lines.fa: صورت نو نو از آن عشق کهن
lines.en: a form ever new, from that ancient love.

tafsir: The love Rumi speaks of is ancient, older than the world.
But it never shows itself the same way twice.
Every day, in the heart, it takes a new form.
This is why the heart never needs to grow old.

poems.name: Do Not Shield Your Chest

lines.en: Do not cover your chest like a shield,
if you are in love with the arrow of that bow.

tafsir: We protect our hearts. Of course we do.
But Rumi says: if you love the archer, why hold up a shield?
Love asks for the courage to be wounded.
An armoured heart is safe, and also closed.

poems.name: Thorns Into Roses

lines.fa: خار عالم در ره عاشق نهاد
lines.en: He laid the world's thorns on the lover's path,

lines.fa: تا که جمله خار را نسرین کند
lines.en: so that he could turn every thorn into a wild rose.

tafsir: Why is the lover's road so full of thorns?
Rumi's answer: so that each one can be transformed.
The difficulties are not the opposite of the path. They are the material of it.
A brave heart walks on, and the thorns begin to bloom.

poems.name: Body and Heart

lines.fa: ای تن گرفته پای دل وی دل گرفته دامنت
lines.en: The body clings to the heart's feet, and the heart clings to your hem;

lines.fa: دامن ز دل اندرمکش تا تن رسد بر بام دل
lines.en: do not pull your hem away from the heart, so the body too may reach the heart's roof.

tafsir: Here is a little chain of love.
The body holds on to the heart. The heart holds on to the Beloved.
Rumi prays: do not let go, so that even the body can be lifted up.
Nothing in us is left behind. The heart pulls everything upward.

poems.name: Hollow Like the Reed

lines.fa: شکم تهی شو و می‌نال همچو نی به نیاز
lines.en: Empty your belly and cry like the reed, in longing;

lines.fa: شکم تهی شو و اسرار گو به سان قلم
lines.en: empty your belly and tell secrets like the pen.

tafsir: This ghazal is about fasting.
A reed flute only sings because it is hollow. A reed pen only writes because it is hollow.
Rumi says the heart works the same way.
Make room inside, and music and meaning can pass through.

poems.name: The Noah of His Time

lines.fa: نوح وقتیست که عشق ابدی کشتی اوست
lines.en: He is the Noah of his time, whose ship is eternal love;

lines.fa: گر جهان زیر و زبر کرد به طوفان رسدش
lines.en: if he turns the world upside down with a flood, it is his right.

tafsir: Noah built an ark while everyone laughed, and it saved what was precious.
Rumi says the true lover is like Noah. His ark is love.
Such a person may shake the world, and they have earned the right.
Courage built on love can survive any flood.

poems.name: Rebel Heart

lines.fa: با دل و جان یاغیم بی‌دل و جان می‌زیم
lines.en: With heart and soul I am a rebel; I live without heart or soul.

lines.fa: باطن من صید شاه ظاهر من در گریز
lines.en: My inner self is the King's prey; my outer self is running away.

tafsir: Rumi is honest about the split inside us.
Deep down, we have already been caught by love.
On the surface, we keep running.
Courage is letting the outer self finally stop, and agree with the heart.
